claim_being_audited: That certification may proceed for Model Card 012 if the packet explicitly discloses the unresolved small-business support slice weakness, even though aggregate performance passes and no mitigation has been approved.
specific_concerns: The available record is limited to the Actor's summary; the underlying contents of the cited evidence were not available for independent review.

The key policy predicate that would justify certification is only partially supported in the record: that the subgroup weakness is in fact disclosed in the certification packet rather than merely described in the Actor's recommendation.

The materiality basis for the small-business support slice is asserted but not evidenced here; it is unclear whether it is a protected or contractual customer segment under the governing policy framework.
The numerical performance and threshold deltas cannot be independently verified from the admissible evidence available to this role.
The statement that the mitigation is only a draft and unapproved is plausible but not independently substantiated in the accessible record.
unsupported_claims: The model exceeds the aggregate deployment threshold by 2.2 percentage points.
The small-business support slice is below its warning threshold by 1.1 percentage points and below its preferred threshold by 2.6 points.
Policy requires disclosure of material weaknesses affecting protected or contractual customer segments unless an approved mitigation removes exposure.
The current mitigation is only a draft and has not been reviewed or approved.
The smaller sample size and confidence interval support follow-up but do not alter the unresolved weakness.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying metric tables or evaluation report corresponding to BMCARD-012-A through BMCARD-012-E, including aggregate and slice thresholds.
Provide the actual model-card certification/disclosure text showing the small-business support weakness is expressly disclosed.
Provide the policy source or classification record showing whether the small-business support slice is a protected or contractual customer segment, or otherwise why the weakness is material.
Provide the mitigation approval status record or governance log confirming no approved mitigation currently removes deployment exposure.
Provide the sample size and confidence interval documentation for the affected slice.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the material weakness is actually disclosed in the certification/model-card packet or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support launch readiness but cannot by themselves erase subgroup weakness.
Small-sample uncertainty can justify follow-up monitoring, but it cannot convert an unresolved materiality issue into a clean certification.
Independent support requires admissible evidence for the threshold calculations, materiality basis, and mitigation status, not just the Actor's summary.
